description: Create a webhook inbox. Returns its ingest URL and a read token (shown once). The same slug is the inbox email address <slug>@ahook.app. Optional slug: a branded username for the inbox (3-63 lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens) — any account may pick one, including anonymous-free via MCP; the inbox never expires, so the slug is permanent. Reserved names are rejected (invalid_slug) and a taken name returns slug_taken.

slug.description: Optional username slug for the inbox (e.g. vintagefinds). Any account may pick one, including anonymous-free via MCP; the inbox never expires, so the slug is permanent.

name: create_inbox
